query:
SELECT 
  m.id,
  m.name,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecules_recettes mr WHERE mr.molecule_id = m.id) as recette_links,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM plant_molecules pm WHERE pm.molecule_id = m.id) as plant_links,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule_synergies ms WHERE ms.molecule1_id = m.id OR ms.molecule2_id = m.id) as synergy_links
FROM molecules m
WHERE m.id IN (90056, 150002, 150003, 150004, 570053, 90049, 150005, 150006, 810005, 570056, 600019, 150001)
ORDER BY m.name;
